dedupe_keys.name: 長電ハス株式会社 gtfs transit data

description: 長電バス株式会社: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 長電バス株式会社. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Yamanouchi, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Yamanouchi, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 5 GTFS schedule feeds for this provider (Yamanouchi, Nagano Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Bike Allowed, Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 急行志賀高原線・急行斑尾高原線 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
